summaries.demographer: Donte Hughes is a 25-year-old U.S.-born white non-Hispanic man living alone in a rented apartment in Scottsdale, Arizona (Q11, Q58, Q87-Q89). He has a bachelor's degree in computer science and works full-time as a salaried full-stack web developer with stable earnings and employer benefits (Q65, Q72, Q76). He has never been married, has no children, and is not cohabiting with a romantic partner, while remaining close to parents and a younger sister in the Phoenix area (Q05, Q84, Q99). His life-course profile is early-career, middle-class, urban-suburban, and oriented toward career mobility and eventual home ownership (Q83, Q108).
summaries.behavioral_economist: Donte is highly planning-oriented and responds strongly to measurable progress, whether in coding, lifting, budgeting, or career certification (Q17, Q32, Q61). He shows low present-bias in finances through automated savings, emergency funds, and avoidance of credit card balances, but experiences temptation around delivery food and hobby gear during work stress (Q56, Q60, Q61). His risk posture is moderate and controlled: he values stable employment and insurance while considering future entrepreneurship only after building runway (Q83, Q108). Peer influence matters selectively through professional mentors, developer friends, and family norms of responsibility rather than broad social pressure (Q02, Q05, Q07).
summaries.political_scientist: Donte identifies as an Independent who leans slightly Democratic, with moderate, pragmatic views and low attachment to party identity (Q24, Q95, Q96). His civic engagement is mainly electoral and informational: he votes in major elections, increasingly researches local races, and pays attention to ballot measures and accountability offices (Q23, Q26). He supports evidence-based governance, criminal justice accountability, climate and water policy, housing affordability, education, and health care access, while expressing skepticism toward performative politics (Q24, Q25, Q27). His institutional trust is conditional: he trusts credible medical and policy sources but prefers verification and implementation details (Q27, Q42).
summaries.psychologist: Donte presents as conscientious, methodical, competitive, and self-regulating, with a strong identity around competence, independence, and growth (Q01, Q43, Q109). His coping style is structured problem-solving through exercise, planning, outdoor resets, and technical or strategic hobbies, though he can become rigid and over-optimized under stress (Q44, Q45, Q50). He maintains close but bounded relationships, relying on a small circle rather than broad emotional disclosure (Q05, Q07, Q49). His motivational architecture is achievement-oriented but increasingly tempered by awareness that balance, spontaneity, and unstructured time are necessary for well-being (Q43, Q108, Q109).
